title: keys array grown to [10] but up to 12 keys are now collectible — later keys silently dropped
evidence:
keys: [10]Key
...
case .S:
...
case .Up, .Down, .Left, .Right, .Enter:
			if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = e.key; keys_n += 1 }
		case .Esc:
			if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = .Esc; keys_n += 1 }
detail: Collectible set is now P/Space, U, T, M, S, Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter, Esc (12 distinct) into a 10-slot array; the guards silently drop Enter/Esc on a busy same-frame burst.
recommended_fix: Size keys to 12 (or count the collectible cases) so no key is ever silently dropped.

title: Closed-panel switch emits Settings_Navigate for Up/Down and collects Left/Right/Enter that are never mapped
evidence:
case .Up:
			append(out, Intent(Settings_Navigate{delta = -1}))
		case .Down:
			append(out, Intent(Settings_Navigate{delta = +1}))
detail: When panel_open is false these Up/Down intents are executor no-ops (gated on panel_open), and Left/Right/Enter are collected into the key array but appear in no non-modal case — dead emissions plus wasted key slots.
recommended_fix: Drop the non-modal .Up/.Down cases and skip collecting Left/Right/Enter unless inp.panel_open.

title: sla_row_rect scales height and y but leaves width 740 raw
detail: Row pitch, offset, and height all go through hud() but the 740px width does not; at x1.50 the drawn 16->24px text can extend past the 740px hit rect, shrinking the click target.

title: step_of appears unused within the diff
evidence:
step_of :: proc(scale: f32) -> u8 {
	steps := UI_SCALE_STEPS // local copy — runtime-indexed
detail: The comment claims panel display + save use it, but no caller appears in this chunk; effect_settings_adjust and draw both read scale_step/ui_scale directly.
recommended_fix: Remove step_of or wire it into the save path; unused symbols invite drift.

title: palette_mode_name defined but never called in this diff
detail: No reference to palette_mode_name appears anywhere in the chunk; either dead or live only in an unshown file.
recommended_fix: Delete it or confirm an out-of-chunk caller exists.

title: Header comment miscounts the settings file size: '4 bytes' vs actual 6
detail: Magic + version + three values + checksum = 6 bytes (buf: [6]u8), not 4; the header contradicts the implementation.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to '6 bytes' before the next reader trusts it.

title: demolish_button_rect keeps an unscaled nil-view default path
detail: The nil fallback returns unscaled geometry while the render path scales; any caller (e.g. a parity twin) omitting the view diverges from the drawn button at x1.25+.
recommended_fix: Make the view parameter mandatory so the scaled and unscaled math cannot diverge.

title: crisis_card_width min-clamp can still overlap the forecast on narrow windows
detail: On narrow win_w, max_card can be negative and the hud(240) floor wins, restoring an overlap with the forecast panel the clamp was built to prevent.
recommended_fix: Document/accept the narrow-window overlap or stack the banner below the forecast under a width threshold.

title: S is not collected when a pipe is selected, so keyboard cannot close a panel opened by chip/Y with a selection live
detail: The chip and pad Y open the panel regardless of sel_pipe, but the S key is gated on sel_pipe < 0 — asymmetric close paths; Esc still works, so impact is minor.
recommended_fix: Collect S whenever panel_open OR sel_pipe < 0 so the toggle key is symmetric.

title: Missing-file test uses a fixed suffix that a stale file can satisfy
detail: Every other test derives a unique nanosecond path; this one pins 99999, so a leftover file from a prior crashed run makes the 'missing file' test read a real file.
recommended_fix: Derive this path from the clock like tmp_settings_path does.
